translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 13.1.2021 (radio)

A new kind of mutated coronavirus is feared in Finland. There are 8 new corona deaths and 324 new corona infections in Finland. Many people want to quit smoking with the help of nicotine products. The deepest snow cover in Finland was measured on Wednesday at Helsinki-Vantaa airport. Towards the end of the week the frost is sharp.
## Mutated coronavirus

![Laboratory technology student Sanni Ouni examines corona samples at the Fimlab laboratory in Tampere.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6000,h_3375,x_0,y_309/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7543245fd8a0221d3e1/1608032591)
Open image viewer
Researchers are finding out how much of the mutated coronavirus can be found in Finland. Photo: Antti Eintola / Yle
Researchers are afraid that the new kind of mutated coronavirus will also start to spread in Finland.
So far about 60 cases of disease have been found in Finland that were caused by the mutated coronavirus.
The mutated coronavirus spreads easily. In Britain, for example, the mutated coronavirus has spread quickly.
If the mutated coronavirus starts to spread in Finland too, there will be more corona infections.
The good news, however, is that the corona vaccine also gives protection against the mutated coronavirus.
## Finland's corona figures
![a nurse takes a corona test from a man](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3641,h_2048,x_0,y_188/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7500835fc9123c66ed8/1607012957)
Open image viewer
New corona infections are found in corona tests. Photo: AOP
8 new corona deaths have been reported in Finland. So far 610 people have died of corona in Finland.
On Wednesday 324 new corona infections were also reported. Almost 40,000 corona infections have been found in Finland so far.
## Nicotine products are popular

![The serving counter of the Vekaranjärvi soldiers' club, with tobacco products on offer behind a curtain.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3840,h_2160,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6026655daeaa4d6ee4b/1571728252)
Open image viewer
Nicotine products help people stop smoking. Photo: Kari Saastamoinen/Yle
Sales of nicotine products have grown. Sales of nicotine chewing gum and other nicotine products have grown by as much as 10 percent during the corona time.
Nicotine products help people stop smoking. Many people want to quit smoking now, because corona disease can become serious because of smoking.
The public health organisation Suomen ASH made a survey on the matter. The results of the survey say that about 10,000 Finns have stopped smoking because of the corona danger.
The public health organisation hopes that in the future nicotine products could be reimbursed by Kela. In the organisation's opinion, people must be supported when they want to quit smoking.
## Snow situation in Southern Finland
![a woman moves snow into a snow pile with a snow shovel](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4032,h_2268,x_0,y_378/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7620485fff052569f17/1610548904)
Open image viewer
A lot of snow has fallen. Photo: Tuija Veirto/ Yle

In Southern Finland a lot of snow has fallen during the early part of the week. On Wednesday the deepest snow cover in the whole of Finland was measured at Helsinki-Vantaa airport. There the snow was 58 centimetres.
The snowfall has disturbed traffic, and in the Helsinki area many buses have been late.

The snow has also caused damage to buildings. For example, in Helsinki and Espoo the roof of a bubble hall collapsed under a thick layer of snow. Nobody was injured, however, because there were no people in the bubble halls at the time.
## The frost gets sharper
![Children on a sledding hill in sunny frosty weather.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11730583)
Open image viewer
Towards the end of the week the snowfall ends and the frost gets sharper. Photo: Markku Ulander / Lehtikuva
The snowfall is gradually ending. On Thursday the weather is dry in most of the country.
Towards the end of the week only a little snow will fall, but the frost is sharp. In the south the frost is between 10 and 20 degrees, in the north even between 30 and 40 degrees.
